summary: Foundation and operational scaffolding for the Phoenix/Elixir backend: project manifest, web module macro factory, production startup, health checks, and validation engine benchmarking. These files wire the runtime together and gate performance regressions in CI.

intentions.title: Establish a composable Phoenix web layer via macro injection
intentions.evidence: barkpark_web.ex defines router/controller/live_view/live_component/html factories via __using__ macros, injecting verified routes, Studio components, i18n, and LiveView layout into every surface from a single source of truth

intentions.title: Support self-contained OTP releases for zero-friction server deploy
intentions.evidence: mix.exs releases config sets include_erts: true so the packaged binary carries its own BEAM runtime; rel/env.sh.eex defaults PHX_SERVER=true so `bin/barkpark start` serves HTTP without extra env setup

intentions.title: Keep prod healthy with a recovery-oriented post-deploy gate
intentions.evidence: prod-postcheck.sh auto-starts the service if stopped, waits for BEAM bind, then probes /api/schemas (no-auth endpoint) — exits 1 with systemctl tail on failure; designed as a recovery guardrail, not passive monitor

intentions.title: Guard validation engine throughput via CI benchmark regression alarm
intentions.evidence: bench/validation_perf.exs runs 100-rule / 200-field / 30-contributor synthetic doc through Evaluator.run_rules/3, exits 1 if median exceeds 100ms; no-start mode avoids Postgres so CI stays fast

intentions.title: Enforce pre-commit quality gates across compilation, deps, formatting, and tests
intentions.evidence: mix.exs aliases define a `precommit` task that chains compile --warnings-as-errors, deps.unlock --unused, format, and test — single command surfaces all regressions before push

intentions.title: Cross-platform image processing without breaking Windows dev setup
intentions.evidence: mix.exs image_dep/0 conditionally omits the :image (libvips NIF) dep on Windows, with env-var overrides; media renditions fall back to ImageMagick CLI backend automatically
